title: Untested Configuration Pushes in Pipelines
damaged_code:
```yaml
# CI configuration does not check YAML properties
test_and_deploy:
  script:
    - cargo test
    - deploy_yaml config.yaml # typos or syntax errors bypass testing
```
pattern: Merging configuration changes directly to repositories or deploying them to production environments without automated testing in CI.
why_bad: Configuration changes are a major cause of production outages. Skipping automated checks or testing configurations in isolation introduces catastrophic syntax or logical errors.
detection: A repository CI/CD pipeline that tests code compilation but contains no validation tests, schemas, or dry-run assertions for configurations.
counterexample:
```yaml
test_configs:
  script:
    - validate_yaml_schema config.yaml
    - test_dry_run_startup --config config.yaml
```
fix: Treat configuration files as code; require the same code reviews, syntax validations, and dry-run startup tests under CI before deployment.
source: Titus Winters, Tom Manshreck, Hyrum Wright - *Software Engineering at Google_ Lessons Learned from Programming Over Time* (2020, O'Reilly Media).pdf, Chapter 16; Heather Adkins et al., - *Building Secure and Reliable Systems* (2020, O'Reilly Media).pdf, Chapter 13.
